female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

female-child-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who list the specific ages of their children fund faster.
female-child-age-faster.body: Providing precise ages for children in the pitch text is associated with increased funding speed for women.

female-boilerplate-slower.title: Female borrowers who use generic template language fund more slowly.
female-boilerplate-slower.body: Pitches from women that utilize generic template language, such as standard greetings or boilerplate phrasing about inspiring others, are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-struggle-mention-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific business struggles or risks fund faster.
female-struggle-mention-faster.body: Pitches from women that identify specific risks, health hazards, or business struggles tend to accelerate funding speed.

male-institutional-training-faster.body: Male borrowers who mention specific institutional affiliations or training history may fund faster.

female-character-adjectives-slower.body: Female borrowers who use descriptive characterizations like 'hardworking' or 'dedicated' may fund more slowly.

female-institutional-boilerplate-faster.body: Female borrowers who include specific institutional boilerplate (e.g., BRAC) may fund faster.

female-daily-life-detail-faster.body: Female borrowers who include specific daily life details, such as pregnancy or work hours, may fund faster.

female-shorter-pitch-faster.body: Female borrowers who write shorter pitches may fund faster than those who write longer ones.

female-supplies-slower.body: Female borrowers who list specific supplies or materials to be purchased may fund more slowly.

female-long-duration-slower.body: Female borrowers who state a business duration of more than three years may fund more slowly.

male-shorter-pitch-faster.body: Male borrowers who write significantly shorter pitches may fund faster than those who write longer ones.

female-schooling-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the purpose of the loan in relation to children's schooling may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-statement-slower.body: Female borrowers who include a specific statement regarding the repayment of the loan may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-history-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly reference a history of successful loan repayments or previous financial history accelerate funding speed.
female-repayment-history-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap upon promotion of boilerplate claim.

female-married-status-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention being married may fund more slowly.

female-geo-location-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific geographic locations (e.g., in the Philippines) may fund faster.
female-geo-location-faster.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

male-child-mention-faster.title: Male borrowers who mention young children or dependents may fund faster, contradicting the trend that family mentions slow men down.
male-child-mention-faster.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-family-roles-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific family roles or members may fund more slowly.
female-family-roles-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that listing both sons and daughters accelerates funding.

female-repayment-record-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly mention a previous loan repayment record may fund more slowly.
female-repayment-record-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that repayment mentions correlate with faster funding.

institutional-detail-slower.title: Pitches that include specific local currency figures or name the microfinance institution tend to experience slower funding speeds for both men and women.
institutional-detail-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap upon promotion of female-struggle-mention-faster.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.
female-community-benefit-faster.retrospective: Auto-retired: confidence dropped below 0.35 after contradiction with schooling observation.

family-mention-interaction.title: Pitches from women that highlight family or community benefits fund faster, while pitches from men that mention family obligations or school fees fund more slowly.
family-mention-interaction.retrospective: Auto-retired: confidence dropped below 0.35 after contradiction with schooling observation.

female-repayment-intent-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly mention their intent to repay the loan may fund faster.
female-repayment-intent-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that repayment statements correlate with slower funding for women.
